payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear explanation of how phrasal compositionality is scored using context-dependent models that compute the likelihood of surrounding context words given a phrase representation.

claims.text: Phrasal compositionality is scored by computing the likelihood of surrounding context words given a phrase representation, which reflects the context-dependent nature of compositionality.
The scoring model uses supervision from automatically-extracted paraphrases to learn compositional functions, which improves the accuracy of the compositionality scores.
Context-dependent scoring models have been shown to improve translation quality in machine translation systems by guiding the decoder based on compositionality scores.
